meta.name: schema-markup-generator
meta.description: Generate JSON-LD structured data markup for rich results in Google Search. Supports FAQ, HowTo, Article, Product, LocalBusiness, and multi-type schemas. Validates against Google requirements and provides implementation guidance. Use when asked to "add schema markup", "generate structured data", "JSON-LD", "rich snippets", "FAQ schema", "product markup", "add structured data to my page", "how to get rich snippets", or any structured data task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为网页生成结构化数据标记，提升搜索引擎展示效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Google搜索中展示更丰富的页面信息
copy.tagline_en: Generate structured data markup for better search engine display
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to display richer page information in Google search results

howto.what: 给网页生成 Google 能识别的结构化数据(JSON-LD)。它会先判断页面类型(文章、产品、FAQ 等),再生成对应代码,并附上搜索结果预览图和安装说明,同时按 Google 要求检查代码是否合格。
howto.when: 当你说“添加 schema 标记”“生成 JSON-LD”“要富摘要”等关键词,或要求为 FAQ、产品、文章等页面做结构化数据时触发。

howto.what_en: Generates JSON-LD structured data for Google rich results. Determines page type (article, product, FAQ, etc.), produces matching schema code, shows a SERP preview and installation guide, and checks against Google requirements.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add schema markup, generate JSON-LD, or request rich snippets, or when you need structured data for FAQ, product, article, and similar pages.

say_en.text: Create Product schema for this product page.
say_en.note: Outputs paste-ready JSON-LD and placement instructions.
